resolution: These are different theories, and each result names the one it is about. POE-EXTERNAL-PREMISE-VS-EMOTIVISM is about O'Connor's 2023 emotivism (no truth value). STMT-NO-OBJECTIVE-MORAL-TRUTHS and STMT-EVIL-PREMISE-NOT-OBJECTIVE come from his 2016 subjectivism, which does not deny truth value, only objectivity. Expressivism in general, including quasi-realism with minimal truth, is not yet refuted or formalized (#182-#185). A result about one of these must not be cited as a result about another.
